## User need

Describe the task and what makes it difficult today. Use synthetic examples and keep private documents or account details out of the request.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you want and how it would help translation or bilingual reading.

## Alternatives

Mention current workarounds and relevant trade-offs. A request does not imply a delivery commitment.
